verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is a non-AI infrastructure-as-code CLI with no agent or model that would invoke tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence covers plan, test, import, state encryption and providers, and none of it shows any built-in AI or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
